mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a temperature of 64 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park, with the new moon overhead.

The Verona Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This long-term roadmap focuses on creating strong neighborhoods, supporting our local businesses, and ensuring sustainable infrastructure for the future.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by a busy Wednesday with the farmer's market and trivia at multiple local venues.

In a report regarding incidents between September 28 and October 5, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash on September 28 where a 16-year-old was cited for reckless driving and operating without a license.
Today's flavor of the day is Georgia Peach. The store is currently closed, but will open today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
